notes: Settled by docs/CASES.md Part 4 rule 3 (YES iff the first-published one-month change in the seasonally adjusted CPI-U, all items, is 0.4 percent or more). Source: the BLS release for August 2025 (https://www.bls.gov/news.release/archives/cpi_09112025.htm; live bls.gov returned HTTP 403 to an automated request on 2026-11-14, so the text was read from the Internet Archive capture https://web.archive.org/web/20260911110826/https://www.bls.gov/news.release/archives/cpi_09112025.htm). Release line: "8:30 a.m. (ET) Thursday, September 11, 2025". First sentence: "The Consumer Price Index for All Urban Consumers (CPI-U) increased 0.4 percent on a seasonally adjusted basis in August, after rising 0.2 percent in July, the U.S." Cross-check in the same release: Table A, 'All items', seasonally adjusted change for Aug. 2025 agrees with the first sentence.
